findings.system: Progeroid Zmpste24-/- mouse muscle progenitors treated with rapamycin (not BubR1)
findings.finding: Rationale: mTORC1 hyperactivity correlates with sarcopenia in BubR1 allelic mice (PMID 31738183); rapamycin reduced senescence in progeroid (HGPS-like) muscle progenitors.
findings.sentence: Interestingly, we observed that mTORC1 inhibition with rapamycin improved myogenic and chondrogenic differentiation and reduced levels of apoptosis and senescence in Zmpste24 -/- MDSPCs.
findings.caveats: Rapamycin was tested in Zmpste24-/- (lamin-processing) progenitors, NOT in BubR1/aneuploid cells; hence L0 for this project. Link to BubR1 is only the correlation in PMID 31738183. Mouse cells in culture.
findings.title: Rapamycin Rescues Age-Related Changes in Muscle-Derived Stem/Progenitor Cells from Progeroid Mice.

findings.system: Progeroid DNA-repair-deficient Ercc1 mice treated with rapamycin
findings.finding: Counter-evidence: rapamycin lowered mTOR signalling but did not extend lifespan or healthspan in another progeroid mouse model.
findings.sentence: Here, we show that rapamycin, while significantly lowering mTOR signaling, failed to improve life span nor healthspan of DNA repair-deficient Ercc1∆/- mice, contrary to DR tested in parallel.
findings.caveats: Ercc1 progeroid model, not BubR1; shows mTOR inhibition does not rescue every progeroid model. EVEROLIMUS/TEMSIROLIMUS are in universe.json but have no data here.
findings.title: Unlike dietary restriction, rapamycin fails to extend lifespan and reduce transcription stress in progeroid DNA repair-deficient mice.

findings.system: Human RMS xenograft in mice (tumour axis, outside the senescence topic)
findings.finding: Rapamycin (sirolimus) abrogated growth of human rhabdomyosarcoma xenografts in mice.
findings.sentence: In this study, we provide evidence that rapamycin (sirolimus) abrogates growth of RMS development in a RMS xenograft mouse model.
findings.caveats: Sporadic RMS xenograft, not MVA-derived; belongs to the tumour consequence, listed only because mTOR is also the sarcopenia/growth axis. Does not test senescence or BubR1.
findings.title: Rapamycin targeting mTOR and hedgehog signaling pathways blocks human rhabdomyosarcoma growth in xenograft murine model.

findings.system: Paediatric kidney transplant recipients (clinical safety context for mTOR inhibitors and growth)
findings.finding: In a small paediatric cohort, low-dose everolimus did not worsen short-term growth versus MMF-based therapy.
findings.sentence: Hence, low-dose EVR does not appear to negatively impact short-term growth in pediatric renal transplant recipients.
findings.caveats: Transplant population (14 vs 14) with concomitant cyclosporine; very different from a child with growth failure and nephrocalcinosis. Safety context only, not evidence of benefit; L0 for the BubR1 question.
findings.title: Longitudinal growth on an everolimus- versus an MMF-based steroid-free immunosuppressive regimen in paediatric renal transplant recipients.

findings.system: Human cancer cell lines (HeLa, A375, A549, QGY) at 1-16 mM
findings.finding: High-dose metformin increased genotoxic stress and deregulated BUBR1 and MAD2 expression.
findings.sentence: Metformin deregulated the expression of BUBR1 and MAD2, two core genes of spindle assembly checkpoint (SAC) that surveillances chromosome segregation.
findings.caveats: Supraphysiological concentrations (mM) in cancer lines; the direction of the BUBR1 change is not stated in the abstract; effect depended on low glucose. The same paper reports genotoxicity in non-cancer cells. No senescence/p53 readout; no BubR1-defective system. Classified L1 only because a SAC/CIN-related effect was measured.
findings.title: High-dose metformin induces a low-glucose dependent genotoxic stress.

findings.system: Senescent human/mouse cells; progeroid Ercc1-/Δ mice (not BubR1)
findings.finding: The combination dasatinib + quercetin reduced senescent-cell burden in aged, irradiated and progeroid Ercc1 mice and extended healthspan in Ercc1 mice.
findings.sentence: In vivo, this combination reduced senescent cell burden in chronologically aged, radiation-exposed, and progeroid Ercc1(-/Δ) mice.
findings.caveats: Name in universe.json is "DASATINIB ANHYDROUS" (plain DASATINIB is absent). Quercetin is not in universe (supplement; see not_approved), so the pair cannot be proposed as such. No experiment in BubR1 hypomorphic mice or MVA cells found. Ercc1 progeroid mice are not a BubR1 system, so L0.
findings.title: The Achilles' heel of senescent cells: from transcriptome to senolytic drugs.

findings.system: Human adipose explants and aged mice (senescent-cell transplant model)
findings.finding: Dasatinib + quercetin eliminated senescent cells in human adipose explants and improved physical function / survival in old mice.
findings.sentence: The senolytic cocktail, dasatinib plus quercetin, which causes selective elimination of senescent cells, decreased the number of naturally occurring senescent cells and their secretion of frailty-related proinflammatory cytokines in explants of human adipose tissue.
findings.caveats: Old/wild-type mice; efficacy in a young child with an aneuploid mosaic background is unknown.
findings.title: Senolytics improve physical function and increase lifespan in old age.

findings.system: Cancer-associated fibroblasts in vitro (MC38 colorectal co-culture)
findings.finding: Counter-evidence: dasatinib/quercetin depleted senescent CAFs but raised IL-6 and promoted EMT/migration of cancer cells, unlike navitoclax.
findings.sentence: Our results demonstrate that some senolytics may have side effects unrelated to their senolytic activity and may promote tumorigenesis.
findings.caveats: In vitro co-culture; relevant to the tumour-predisposition concern. Quercetin component is not an approved drug.
findings.title: The Differential Effect of Senolytics on SASP Cytokine Secretion and Regulation of EMT by CAFs.

findings.system: Triple-negative breast cancer cells with therapy-induced senescence (in vitro and mouse)
findings.finding: Venetoclax induced apoptosis in therapy-senescent TNBC cells.
findings.sentence: Interestingly, venetoclax treatment following TIS induction led to pronounced apoptotic cell death and significant changes in SA-β-gal and IL-6, implying enhanced sensitivity post-senescence induction.
findings.caveats: Cancer cells after PARP inhibitor + radiation; not an aneuploid-syndrome or BubR1 system; BCL-2 selective (navitoclax, BCL-2/BCL-xL, is not approved). A cell-killing senolytic strategy carries the clearance risks listed under against_or_risk.
findings.title: Talazoparib and radiation enhance the senolytic efficacy of venetoclax in therapy-induced senescent triple-negative breast cancer cells.

findings.system: Human preadipocytes/HUVEC senescence and aged mice treated with JAK inhibitors
findings.finding: JAK inhibitors suppressed the SASP of senescent human cells and alleviated inflammation and frailty in aged mice. The class includes RUXOLITINIB, BARICITINIB, TOFACITINIB (present in universe.json).
findings.sentence: Senescent human primary preadipocytes as well as human umbilical vein endothelial cells (HUVECs) developed a SASP that could be suppressed by targeting the JAK pathway using RNAi or JAK inhibitors.
findings.caveats: The abstract does not name the inhibitor (full text not retrievable, HTTP 500), so no individual drug is assigned (drug=null). Aged wild-type mice and non-aneuploid cells. Immunosuppression risk in a child is not addressed by the source.
findings.title: JAK inhibition alleviates the cellular senescence-associated secretory phenotype and frailty in old age.

findings.system: Aneuploid (trisomic) mouse embryonic fibroblasts and aneuploid human cancer cell lines
findings.finding: Chloroquine (autophagy inhibitor) was among compounds causing lethality in aneuploid but not euploid cells.
findings.sentence: Compounds that cause lethality in aneuploid, but not euploid, cells could therefore provide new cancer therapies. We have identified the energy stress-inducing agent AICAR, the protein folding inhibitor 17-AAG, and the autophagy inhibitor chloroquine as exhibiting this property.
findings.caveats: Selective toxicity to aneuploid cells could eliminate aneuploid clones, but in a mosaic child it could also injure aneuploid normal tissue: direction left "unclear". Tested in trisomic MEFs / cancer lines, not BUB1B-deficient cells. AICAR and 17-AAG are not approved (see not_approved).
findings.title: Identification of aneuploidy-selective antiproliferation compounds.

findings.system: Embryonal rhabdomyosarcoma cell lines (in vitro; tumour axis)
findings.finding: Chloroquine combined with a PI3K/mTOR inhibitor induced apoptosis in embryonal RMS cells.
findings.sentence: Here, we identify a synthetic lethal interaction of BEZ235 together with the lysosomotropic agent chloroquine (CQ), which is effective against embryonal rhabdomyosarcoma (ERMS).
findings.caveats: Requires the non-approved PI3K/mTOR inhibitor BEZ235; sporadic ERMS lines. Tumour axis, not senescence.
findings.title: Dual phosphatidylinositol 3-kinase/mammalian target of rapamycin inhibitor NVP-BEZ235 synergizes with chloroquine to induce apoptosis in embryonal rhabdomyosarcoma.

findings.system: Human cells that evade senescence after CDK4/6 inhibitor treatment (PREPRINT, bioRxiv)
findings.finding: Cells that escape CDK4/6-inhibitor senescence mis-segregate chromosomes and become aneuploid with a weakened mitotic checkpoint. Class includes PALBOCICLIB, RIBOCICLIB, ABEMACICLIB (present in universe.json).
findings.sentence: We show here that enlarged CDK4/6i-treated cells that evade senescence mis-segregate chromosomes due to defective chromosomal alignment and a weakened mitotic checkpoint, leading to aneuploidy and DNA damage.
findings.caveats: PREPRINT (not peer-reviewed). The abstract names the class (CDK4/6i), not an individual drug; hence drug=null. Cell lines. Risk signal: forcing senescence/escape in a cell with an already weak SAC.
findings.title: Cell enlargement causes mitotic errors and aneuploidy in cells that evade senescence after CDK4/6 inhibition

findings.system: Pancreatic cancer cells and mouse models (NAD+ precursors NAM, NR, NMN)
findings.finding: Counter-evidence: NAM and NMN supplementation conferred chemotherapy resistance and supported cancer growth in mice.
findings.sentence: In murine models, both immunocompetent and immunodeficient, supplementation with NAM and NMN similarly conferred resistance to standard chemotherapy and supported cancer growth.
findings.caveats: NIACINAMIDE (= nicotinamide, NAM) is the universe.json name. Pancreatic cancer, not RMS or MVA; shows that raising NAD+ is not neutral in a tumour-prone child. BubR1 benefit data come from NMN (not approved).
findings.title: Vitamin B3 derivatives support pancreatic cancer cell survival and chemotherapy resistance.

background_evidence.system: Mouse BubR1 hypomorph (BubR1 H/H), muscle and fat: genetic inactivation of p16Ink4a
background_evidence.finding: Genetic inactivation of p16Ink4a attenuates senescence and premature ageing in BubR1-insufficient mice (p16 is an effector).
background_evidence.sentence: Inactivation of p16(Ink4a) in BubR1-insufficient mice attenuates both cellular senescence and premature ageing in these tissues.
background_evidence.caveats: Genetic (knockout) experiment, not a drug. Establishes the mechanism p16-dependent senescence -> progeroid tissue phenotype in mice with BubR1 insufficiency. Abstract-only verification (full text HTTP 500).
background_evidence.title: Opposing roles for p16Ink4a and p19Arf in senescence and ageing caused by BubR1 insufficiency.

background_evidence.system: Mouse BubR1 hypomorph: genetic inactivation of p19Arf
background_evidence.finding: Opposite role of p19Arf: its inactivation worsens senescence and ageing in BubR1 mutant mice (the p19Arf/p53 axis is protective).
background_evidence.sentence: Conversely, p19(Arf) inactivation exacerbates senescence and ageing in BubR1 mutant mice.
background_evidence.caveats: Genetic knockout; implies that blocking the Arf/p53 axis would be expected to worsen, not help, this phenotype in mice.
background_evidence.title: Opposing roles for p16Ink4a and p19Arf in senescence and ageing caused by BubR1 insufficiency.

background_evidence.system: Mouse BubR1 progeroid model (INK-ATTAC transgene)
background_evidence.finding: Elimination of p16Ink4a-positive cells by a transgene in the BubR1 progeroid background delays age-related phenotypes in fat, skeletal muscle and eye.
background_evidence.sentence: In tissues--such as adipose tissue, skeletal muscle and eye--in which p16(Ink4a) contributes to the acquisition of age-related pathologies, life-long removal of p16(Ink4a)-expressing cells delayed onset of these phenotypes.
background_evidence.caveats: GENETIC elimination (INK-ATTAC suicide transgene activated by the dimerizer AP20187, not a marketed drug). It is NOT evidence for any approved drug. Only supports the concept that senescent cells contribute to the BubR1-insufficiency phenotype.
background_evidence.title: Clearance of p16Ink4a-positive senescent cells delays ageing-associated disorders.

background_evidence.system: Mouse BubR1 progeroid model (INK-ATTAC transgene)
background_evidence.finding: The same paper states that the transgene removes p16Ink4a-positive cells in the BubR1 progeroid background upon drug (dimerizer) treatment.
background_evidence.sentence: Here we show that in the BubR1 progeroid mouse background, INK-ATTAC removes p16(Ink4a)-positive senescent cells upon drug treatment.
background_evidence.caveats: The "drug" is the experimental dimerizer AP20187 acting on a transgene; the paper is about genetic cell elimination.
background_evidence.title: Clearance of p16Ink4a-positive senescent cells delays ageing-associated disorders.

background_evidence.system: Mouse BubR1 progeroid mice lacking p53 or p21
background_evidence.finding: p53 delays functional decline of muscle and fat via p21 by restraining p16-mediated senescence of progenitor cells: p53 is protective in BubR1 insufficiency.
background_evidence.sentence: We show that p53 delays functional decline of skeletal muscle and fat in a p21-dependent fashion by inhibiting p16(Ink4a)-mediated senescence of progenitor cells.
background_evidence.caveats: Genetic data. Implication: a p53 inhibitor would be predicted to worsen muscle/fat decline (and tumour risk) in this context.
background_evidence.title: p21 both attenuates and drives senescence and aging in BubR1 progeroid mice.

background_evidence.system: Mouse BubR1 progeroid mice lacking p53 or p21 (lens)
background_evidence.finding: In the lens p21 promotes senescence and cataract formation while p53 protects independently of p21, so p21 has dual, tissue-dependent roles.
background_evidence.sentence: Strikingly, p53 also attenuates the formation of cataractous lenses, but here its antiaging effect is p21 independent, as we found p21 to promote senescence of lens epithelial cells and cataract formation.
background_evidence.caveats: Genetic data; a global p21 intervention would have opposite effects in different tissues.
background_evidence.title: p21 both attenuates and drives senescence and aging in BubR1 progeroid mice.

background_evidence.system: Mouse embryonic fibroblasts and mice with low BubR1
background_evidence.finding: Mice with low BubR1 develop progressive aneuploidy and progeroid features; graded BubR1 reduction in MEFs increases aneuploidy and senescence.
background_evidence.sentence: Graded reduction of BubR1 expression in mouse embryonic fibroblasts causes increased aneuploidy and senescence.
background_evidence.caveats: Mouse cells. Primary source for the BubR1 -> senescence link in cells; no human BUBR1-deficient cell senescence data located (see no_evidence).
background_evidence.title: BubR1 insufficiency causes early onset of aging-associated phenotypes and infertility in mice.

background_evidence.system: Mouse model of MVA allelic combinations (BubR1 H/L1002P etc.)
background_evidence.finding: Sarcopenia predisposition in MVA-allele mice correlated with mTORC1 hyperactivity.
background_evidence.sentence: Additionally, mice carrying monoallelic BubR1 mutations were prone to select MVA-related pathologies later in life, with predisposition to sarcopenia correlating with mTORC1 hyperactivity.
background_evidence.caveats: Correlation only (mTORC1 activity vs sarcopenia). No rapamycin or other drug rescue experiment is reported in the abstract. Full text could not be retrieved from Europe PMC (HTTP 500), so the body could not be checked for drug experiments.
background_evidence.title: BubR1 allelic effects drive phenotypic heterogeneity in mosaic-variegated aneuploidy progeria syndrome.

background_evidence.system: Mouse model of MVA allelic combinations (BubR1 H/L1002P)
background_evidence.finding: Different MVA allele combinations give different progeroid severity; reduced SASP complexity in muscle where the phenotype was milder.
background_evidence.sentence: Strikingly, although these mice had a reduction in total BUBR1 and spectrum of MVA phenotypes similar to that of BubR1H/H mice, several progeroid pathologies were attenuated in severity, which in skeletal muscle coincided with reduced senescence-associated secretory phenotype complexity.
background_evidence.caveats: Mouse data; relevant because the child carries a null allele plus a missense VUS (allele-specific effects beyond protein dosage).
background_evidence.title: BubR1 allelic effects drive phenotypic heterogeneity in mosaic-variegated aneuploidy progeria syndrome.

background_evidence.system: Mouse model of MVA allelic combinations (BubR1 H/L1002P)
background_evidence.finding: The BubR1 H/L1002P mice reproduce cancer predisposition and several features of the child (dwarfism, sarcopenia, short lifespan).
background_evidence.sentence: BubR1H/L1002P mice were viable and exhibited many MVA features, including cancer predisposition and various progeroid phenotypes, such as short lifespan, dwarfism, lipodystrophy, sarcopenia, and low cardiac stress tolerance.
background_evidence.caveats: Mouse model; the closest preclinical model to a null + hypomorphic compound genotype.
background_evidence.title: BubR1 allelic effects drive phenotypic heterogeneity in mosaic-variegated aneuploidy progeria syndrome.

background_evidence.system: Human diploid cells with induced chromosome missegregation
background_evidence.finding: Chromosome missegregation causes a delay with nuclear accumulation of p53 and p21; the p53 pathway limits propagation of aneuploid human cells.
background_evidence.sentence: In this study, we show that in otherwise diploid human cells, chromosome missegregation causes a cell cycle delay with nuclear accumulation of the tumor suppressor p53 and the cyclin kinase inhibitor p21.
background_evidence.caveats: Human cell lines with induced missegregation, not BUB1B patient cells.
background_evidence.title: Proliferation of aneuploid human cells is limited by a p53-dependent mechanism.

background_evidence.system: Mouse aneuploidy models (SAC-defective)
background_evidence.finding: Aneuploidy activates p53 and loss of p53 drastically accelerates tumour development in two aneuploidy models.
background_evidence.sentence: We show that aneuploidy activates p53 and that loss of p53 drastically accelerates tumor development in two independent aneuploidy models.
background_evidence.caveats: Mouse genetic data; basis for the concern that p53 inhibition is dangerous in an aneuploidy-prone, tumour-prone child.
background_evidence.title: The ATM-p53 pathway suppresses aneuploidy-induced tumorigenesis.

background_evidence.system: Primary human fibroblasts (IMR90) with Mad2 depletion
background_evidence.finding: SAC-gene depletion induced aneuploidy and premature senescence with p53, p14ARF and p21 up-regulation but NOT p16INK4A in human fibroblasts.
background_evidence.sentence: IMR90 cells showed typical features of senescent cells, like senescence-associated (SA) beta galactosidase expression, including up-regulation of p53 and p14ARF proteins and of p21(waf1) as well, but not of p16(INK4A) cyclin-dependent kinase (Cdk) inhibitor.
background_evidence.caveats: MAD2 (not BUB1B) depletion in human fibroblasts; the p53/p21-dominant (p16-independent) pattern differs from the p16-dependent mouse BubR1 tissue phenotype.
background_evidence.title: MAD2 depletion triggers premature cellular senescence in human primary fibroblasts by activating a p53 pathway preventing aneuploid cells propagation.

background_evidence.system: Aneuploid human cell lines
background_evidence.finding: The chromosomally unstable progeny of aneuploid cells remain subject to p53-induced senescence and are eliminated.
background_evidence.sentence: Indeed, while these aneuploid cells are able to survive for extended periods in vitro, their chromosomally unstable progeny remain subject to p53-induced senescence and growth restriction, leading to subsequent elimination from the aneuploid pool.
background_evidence.caveats: In vitro aneuploid cell lines.
background_evidence.title: P53 induces senescence in the unstable progeny of aneuploid cells.

background_evidence.system: Human preimplantation embryos
background_evidence.finding: Aneuploidy triggers proteotoxic stress, autophagy, p53 signalling and apoptosis independently of DNA damage in human blastocysts.
background_evidence.sentence: Immunostaining corroborated that aneuploidy triggers proteotoxic stress, autophagy, p53-signaling, and apoptosis independent from DNA damage.
background_evidence.caveats: Human embryos; developmental context.
background_evidence.title: Complex aneuploidy triggers autophagy and p53-mediated apoptosis and impairs the second lineage segregation in human preimplantation embryos.

background_evidence.system: BubR1-deficient mouse cortex (Trp53 co-deletion)
background_evidence.finding: In BubR1 mutant neural progenitors chromosomal defects and DNA damage activate P53 and apoptosis; Trp53 co-deletion left residual (p53-independent) apoptosis.
background_evidence.sentence: Chromosomal defects and accompanying DNA damage result in P53 activation and apoptotic cell death in BubR1 mutants.
background_evidence.caveats: Mouse neurodevelopment (microcephaly); shows p53 activation in BubR1 deficiency.
background_evidence.title: P53 independent pathogenic mechanisms contribute to BubR1 microcephaly.

background_evidence.system: Review on congenital aneuploidy syndromes (secondary source)
background_evidence.finding: In organismal aneuploidy TP53 is usually functional, potentially triggering senescence or cell death, which impedes development.
background_evidence.sentence: At the cellular level, unlike in cancer, organismal aneuploidy typically occurs in the presence of a functional TP53 pathway, potentially triggering senescence or cell death, which impedes development.
background_evidence.caveats: Review (secondary), verified in the full text.
background_evidence.title: The Hallmarks of Aneuploidy in Cancer and Congenital Syndromes.

background_evidence.system: Review (secondary source) on MVA tumour risk
background_evidence.finding: MVA patients have a high risk of solid tumours including Wilms tumour and rhabdomyosarcoma.
background_evidence.sentence: Patients with mosaic variegated aneuploidy syndrome have a high risk of developing several types of solid tumors, including Wilms tumor and rhabdomyosarcoma (60, 83).
background_evidence.caveats: Review (secondary) verified in full text; clinical statement citing the primary literature. Not about senescence.
background_evidence.title: The Hallmarks of Aneuploidy in Cancer and Congenital Syndromes.

background_evidence.system: Embryonal rhabdomyosarcoma from an MVA patient with biallelic BUB1B mutations
background_evidence.finding: Patient tumour (E-RMS) showed gains/losses typical of sporadic E-RMS.
background_evidence.sentence: To further investigate the role of BUB1B in cancer predisposition we performed comparative genomic hybridization analysis in an embryonal rhabdomyosarcoma from an MVA case with biallelic BUB1B mutations, revealing aneuploidies typical of sporadic E-RMS, with gain of chromosomes 3, 8, 13 and loss of chromosomes 9, 14, X.
background_evidence.caveats: Tumour observation in an MVA/BUB1B patient; says nothing about senescence or p53.
background_evidence.title: Comparative genomic hybridization and BUB1B mutation analyses in childhood cancers associated with mosaic variegated aneuploidy syndrome.

background_evidence.system: Cells from PCS/MVA patients (monoallelic BUB1B mutations)
background_evidence.finding: Patient cells show reduced BubR1 protein and kinetochore localisation.
background_evidence.sentence: BubR1 in the cells from two patients showed both reduced protein expression and diminished kinetochore localization.
background_evidence.caveats: Patient-derived cells, but the abstract reports no senescence, p53 or p21 measurement. Included only to show what patient-cell data exist.
background_evidence.title: Monoallelic BUB1B mutations and defective mitotic-spindle checkpoint in seven families with premature chromatid separation (PCS) syndrome.

background_evidence.system: Mouse BubR1 progeroid mice with Pak2 depletion (genetic)
background_evidence.finding: Genetic depletion of Pak2 attenuated aging phenotypes and extended lifespan in BubR1 progeroid mice.
background_evidence.sentence: Importantly, depletion of Pak2 in BubR1 progeroid mice attenuated the onset of aging-associated phenotypes and extended life span.
background_evidence.caveats: Genetic depletion, not a drug. No approved Pak2 drug identified in this search.
background_evidence.title: Pak2 kinase promotes cellular senescence and organismal aging.

background_evidence.system: Mouse BubR1 H/H mice with genetic sFRP3 inhibition
background_evidence.finding: Genetic sFRP3 inhibition restores the reduced body and brain size of BubR1 H/H mice.
background_evidence.sentence: Using BubR1H/H mice as a novel mouse model of accelerated aging, we report that genetic inhibition of sFRP3 restores the reduced body and brain size observed in BubR1H/H mice.
background_evidence.caveats: Genetic; no drug.
background_evidence.title: sFRP3 inhibition improves age-related cellular changes in BubR1 progeroid mice.

background_evidence.system: Mouse BubR1 overexpression transgene
background_evidence.finding: High BubR1 expression reduces tumorigenesis and preserves genomic integrity even with oncogenic Ras.
background_evidence.sentence: Using a transgenic approach in mice, we show that sustained high-level expression of BubR1 preserves genomic integrity and reduces tumorigenesis, even in the presence of genetic alterations that strongly promote aneuplodization and cancer, such as oncogenic Ras.
background_evidence.caveats: Genetic overexpression; shows BubR1 dosage is causal. (Sentence copied with the source spelling "aneuplodization").
background_evidence.title: Increased expression of BubR1 protects against aneuploidy and cancer and extends healthy lifespan.

background_evidence.system: Mouse BubR1 hypomorph + SIRT2/NAD+ axis
background_evidence.finding: BubR1 loss with age is attributed to NAD+ decline and SIRT2-dependent deacetylation; SIRT2 overexpression or NMN increases BubR1 abundance in mice.
background_evidence.sentence: Overexpression of SIRT2 or treatment of mice with the NAD(+) precursor nicotinamide mononucleotide (NMN) increases BubR1 abundance in vivo.
background_evidence.caveats: The precursor tested is NMN, which is NOT in universe.json (not an approved drug). Nicotinamide (NIACINAMIDE) and niacin are different molecules; the result cannot be transferred to them. In the child one allele is null and the other a VUS: the benefit of raising BubR1 abundance depends on the missense allele producing functional protein.
background_evidence.title: SIRT2 induces the checkpoint kinase BubR1 to increase lifespan.

background_evidence.system: BubR1 H/H mice with SIRT2 overexpression (genetic)
background_evidence.finding: Genetic SIRT2 overexpression in BubR1 H/H animals increases median lifespan, more in males.
background_evidence.sentence: Overexpression of SIRT2 in BubR1(H/H) animals increases median lifespan, with a greater effect in male mice.
background_evidence.caveats: Transgenic overexpression, not a drug. The closest lifespan rescue of a BubR1 hypomorph in the NAD+/sirtuin area.
background_evidence.title: SIRT2 induces the checkpoint kinase BubR1 to increase lifespan.

background_evidence.system: Wild-type mice with SIRT2 overexpression
background_evidence.finding: SIRT2 overexpression did not extend lifespan in mice with normal BubR1 (benefit appears tied to low BubR1).
background_evidence.sentence: Overall, we conclude that strategies to enhance SIRT2 protein levels may not lead to increased longevity.
background_evidence.caveats: Wild-type background; moderates the NAD+/SIRT2 hypothesis.
background_evidence.title: SIRT2 transgenic over-expression does not impact lifespan in mice.

not_approved.name: NAVITOCLAX (ABT-263)
not_approved.reason: BCL-2/BCL-xL inhibitor senolytic in aged/irradiated mice; not in universe.json.
not_approved.sentence: we screened a collection of compounds and identified ABT263 (a specific inhibitor of the anti-apoptotic proteins BCL-2 and BCL-xL) as a potent senolytic drug.

not_approved.name: QUERCETIN
not_approved.reason: Partner of dasatinib in the senolytic cocktail; flavonoid not in universe.json (supplement).
not_approved.sentence: Dasatinib eliminated senescent human fat cell progenitors, while quercetin was more effective against senescent human endothelial cells and mouse BM-MSCs.

not_approved.name: FISETIN
not_approved.reason: Flavonoid senotherapeutic in progeroid Ercc1 and aged mice; not in universe.json.
not_approved.sentence: The natural product fisetin has senotherapeutic activity in mice and in human tissues.

not_approved.name: NICOTINAMIDE MONONUCLEOTIDE (NMN)
not_approved.reason: The NAD+ precursor that raised BubR1 in mice; not in universe.json. Do not transfer to NIACINAMIDE/NIACIN.
not_approved.sentence: Overexpression of SIRT2 or treatment of mice with the NAD(+) precursor nicotinamide mononucleotide (NMN) increases BubR1 abundance in vivo.

not_approved.name: NICOTINAMIDE RIBOSIDE
not_approved.reason: Not in universe.json; no experiment with BubR1/aneuploid cells found; only named as a marketed nutraceutical in a pancreatic cancer paper.
not_approved.sentence: Its dietary precursors, commonly referred to as vitamin B3 derivatives, including nicotinamide (NAM), nicotinamide riboside (NR), and nicotinamide mononucleotide (NMN), are marketed as nutraceuticals with potential energy-boosting, cardioprotective, and neuroprotective benefits.

not_approved.name: AICAR (ACADESINE)
not_approved.reason: Aneuploid-selective lethal compound in trisomic MEFs; not in universe.json.
not_approved.sentence: AICAR induces p53-mediated apoptosis in primary mouse embryonic fibroblasts (MEFs) trisomic for chromosome 1, 13, 16, or 19.

not_approved.name: 17-AAG / 17-DMAG (HSP90 inhibitors)
not_approved.reason: Aneuploid-selective / senolytic HSP90 inhibitors; not in universe.json.
not_approved.sentence: Treatment of Ercc1 -/∆ mice, a mouse model of a human progeroid syndrome, with the HSP90 inhibitor 17-DMAG extended healthspan, delayed the onset of several age-related symptoms and reduced p16INK4a expression.

not_approved.name: AP20187 (dimerizer for INK-ATTAC)
not_approved.reason: Experimental dimerizer used to trigger the suicide transgene; not a marketed drug.
not_approved.sentence: To explore the physiological relevance and consequences of naturally occurring senescent cells, here we use a previously established transgene, INK-ATTAC, to induce apoptosis in p16(Ink4a)-expressing cells of wild-type mice by injection of AP20187 twice a week starting at one year of age.

not_approved.name: NUTLINS / MDM2 inhibitors (p53 activators)
not_approved.reason: No MDM2 inhibitor in universe.json (checked nutlin, idasanutlin); no literature on them in BubR1/MVA found.

no_evidence: No study found (Europe PMC, many query combinations) that treats BubR1 hypomorphic mice or BUB1B/BUBR1-deficient human cells with an approved senolytic (dasatinib, venetoclax), SASP inhibitor, rapamycin/sirolimus/everolimus, metformin or a NAD+ precursor and measures senescence or lifespan. The only drug-in-BubR1-mouse result is with NMN (not approved).
The "senolytic" experiment in the BubR1 progeroid background (PMID 22048312) is a genetic suicide transgene (INK-ATTAC), not a drug experiment.

No study of senescence, p16, p21 or p53 in cells derived from MVA/BUB1B patients was found. The patient-cell data located (PMID 16411201) report reduced BubR1 and kinetochore localisation only. Senescence data are from mouse cells (PMID 15208629) and from non-BUB1B human models (MAD2 depletion, PMID 22170163; induced missegregation, PMID 20123995).
No clinical (L3) observation of senescence, SASP or p53 activity in MVA/BUB1B patients, and no clinical study of a senotherapeutic in MVA, was found.
No approved p53-activating or -inhibiting drug was found tested in BubR1/MVA models; the usual p53 activators (nutlin, idasanutlin) are not in universe.json.

rapamycin/mTOR in BubR1 models: the MVA-allele mouse paper (PMID 31738183) reports mTORC1 hyperactivity only as a correlation with sarcopenia in its abstract; whether it ran a rapamycin test could not be checked because Europe PMC returns HTTP 500 for its full text.
Full text was not retrievable (HTTP 500) for most older NIH-manuscript papers (PMC3785294, PMC4194088, PMC6934189, PMC2594014, PMC4655580, PMC4531078); for those, verification is abstract-only.
Metformin and nicotinamide riboside in BubR1-deficient or senescent aneuploid cells: no experiment found.
No approved drug was found that is shown to rescue a BubR1-hypomorph phenotype (L2 not reached by any approved drug).

against_or_risk.finding: Clearance of p16Ink4a-positive cells in wild-type mice delayed tumorigenesis without apparent side effects (counterpoint to the worry that clearing senescent cells raises tumour risk, but only in non-aneuploid mice, with a transgene).
against_or_risk.sentence: The clearance of p16(Ink4a)-positive cells delayed tumorigenesis and attenuated age-related deterioration of several organs without apparent side effects, including kidney, heart and fat, where clearance preserved the functionality of glomeruli, cardio-protective KATP channels and adipocytes, respectively.
against_or_risk.caveats: Genetic clearance in wild-type mice; does not test pharmacological senolytics nor BubR1-deficient or tumour-prone animals.
against_or_risk.title: Naturally occurring p16(Ink4a)-positive cells shorten healthy lifespan.

against_or_risk.system: Mouse wound-healing model with elimination of senescent cells
against_or_risk.finding: Senescent cells accelerate wound closure through PDGF-AA; eliminating them delays repair (a physiological cost of senolysis).
against_or_risk.sentence: We show that senescent fibroblasts and endothelial cells appear very early in response to a cutaneous wound, where they accelerate wound closure by inducing myofibroblast differentiation through the secretion of platelet-derived growth factor AA (PDGF-AA).
against_or_risk.caveats: Genetic elimination model in mice; shows senescence also has beneficial roles.
against_or_risk.title: An essential role for senescent cells in optimal wound healing through secretion of PDGF-AA.

against_or_risk.finding: A single nonsense MVA allele is enough to enhance growth of carcinogen-induced tumours.
against_or_risk.sentence: BubR1(+/GTTA) mice develop mild aneuploidies and show enhanced growth of carcinogen-induced tumors.
against_or_risk.caveats: Baseline tumour risk of a null allele (the child has p.Leu737*); any intervention must be weighed against this predisposition.
against_or_risk.title: Reduced life- and healthspan in mice carrying a mono-allelic BubR1 MVA mutation.

against_or_risk.system: Paediatric transplant literature (introductory statement of the everolimus growth study)
against_or_risk.finding: The authors state a concern that mTOR inhibitors may interfere with longitudinal bone growth in children.
against_or_risk.sentence: Concerns have been raised that mammalian target of rapamycin inhibitors in pediatric transplant recipients might interfere with longitudinal bone growth by inhibition of growth factor signaling and growth plate chondrocyte proliferation.
against_or_risk.caveats: Statement of concern by the authors (the same study then found no short-term difference at low dose). Relevant because the child has short stature and growth delay. Rapamycin class (sirolimus/everolimus).
against_or_risk.title: Longitudinal growth on an everolimus- versus an MMF-based steroid-free immunosuppressive regimen in paediatric renal transplant recipients.

against_or_risk.system: Progeroid DNA-repair-deficient Ercc1 mice treated with rapamycin
against_or_risk.finding: Counter-evidence: rapamycin lowered mTOR signalling but did not extend lifespan or healthspan in another progeroid mouse model.
against_or_risk.sentence: Here, we show that rapamycin, while significantly lowering mTOR signaling, failed to improve life span nor healthspan of DNA repair-deficient Ercc1∆/- mice, contrary to DR tested in parallel.
against_or_risk.caveats: Ercc1 progeroid model, not BubR1; shows mTOR inhibition does not rescue every progeroid model. EVEROLIMUS/TEMSIROLIMUS are in universe.json but have no data here.
against_or_risk.title: Unlike dietary restriction, rapamycin fails to extend lifespan and reduce transcription stress in progeroid DNA repair-deficient mice.

against_or_risk.system: Human cancer cell lines (HeLa, A375, A549, QGY) at 1-16 mM
against_or_risk.finding: High-dose metformin increased genotoxic stress and deregulated BUBR1 and MAD2 expression.
against_or_risk.sentence: Metformin deregulated the expression of BUBR1 and MAD2, two core genes of spindle assembly checkpoint (SAC) that surveillances chromosome segregation.
against_or_risk.caveats: Supraphysiological concentrations (mM) in cancer lines; the direction of the BUBR1 change is not stated in the abstract; effect depended on low glucose. The same paper reports genotoxicity in non-cancer cells. No senescence/p53 readout; no BubR1-defective system. Classified L1 only because a SAC/CIN-related effect was measured.
against_or_risk.title: High-dose metformin induces a low-glucose dependent genotoxic stress.

against_or_risk.system: Cancer-associated fibroblasts in vitro (MC38 colorectal co-culture)
against_or_risk.finding: Counter-evidence: dasatinib/quercetin depleted senescent CAFs but raised IL-6 and promoted EMT/migration of cancer cells, unlike navitoclax.
against_or_risk.sentence: Our results demonstrate that some senolytics may have side effects unrelated to their senolytic activity and may promote tumorigenesis.
against_or_risk.caveats: In vitro co-culture; relevant to the tumour-predisposition concern. Quercetin component is not an approved drug.
against_or_risk.title: The Differential Effect of Senolytics on SASP Cytokine Secretion and Regulation of EMT by CAFs.

against_or_risk.system: Human cells that evade senescence after CDK4/6 inhibitor treatment (PREPRINT, bioRxiv)
against_or_risk.finding: Cells that escape CDK4/6-inhibitor senescence mis-segregate chromosomes and become aneuploid with a weakened mitotic checkpoint. Class includes PALBOCICLIB, RIBOCICLIB, ABEMACICLIB (present in universe.json).
against_or_risk.sentence: We show here that enlarged CDK4/6i-treated cells that evade senescence mis-segregate chromosomes due to defective chromosomal alignment and a weakened mitotic checkpoint, leading to aneuploidy and DNA damage.
against_or_risk.caveats: PREPRINT (not peer-reviewed). The abstract names the class (CDK4/6i), not an individual drug; hence drug=null. Cell lines. Risk signal: forcing senescence/escape in a cell with an already weak SAC.
against_or_risk.title: Cell enlargement causes mitotic errors and aneuploidy in cells that evade senescence after CDK4/6 inhibition

against_or_risk.system: Pancreatic cancer cells and mouse models (NAD+ precursors NAM, NR, NMN)
against_or_risk.finding: Counter-evidence: NAM and NMN supplementation conferred chemotherapy resistance and supported cancer growth in mice.
against_or_risk.sentence: In murine models, both immunocompetent and immunodeficient, supplementation with NAM and NMN similarly conferred resistance to standard chemotherapy and supported cancer growth.
against_or_risk.caveats: NIACINAMIDE (= nicotinamide, NAM) is the universe.json name. Pancreatic cancer, not RMS or MVA; shows that raising NAD+ is not neutral in a tumour-prone child. BubR1 benefit data come from NMN (not approved).
against_or_risk.title: Vitamin B3 derivatives support pancreatic cancer cell survival and chemotherapy resistance.

against_or_risk.system: Mouse BubR1 hypomorph: genetic inactivation of p19Arf
against_or_risk.finding: Opposite role of p19Arf: its inactivation worsens senescence and ageing in BubR1 mutant mice (the p19Arf/p53 axis is protective).
against_or_risk.sentence: Conversely, p19(Arf) inactivation exacerbates senescence and ageing in BubR1 mutant mice.
against_or_risk.caveats: Genetic knockout; implies that blocking the Arf/p53 axis would be expected to worsen, not help, this phenotype in mice.
against_or_risk.title: Opposing roles for p16Ink4a and p19Arf in senescence and ageing caused by BubR1 insufficiency.

against_or_risk.system: Mouse BubR1 progeroid mice lacking p53 or p21
against_or_risk.finding: p53 delays functional decline of muscle and fat via p21 by restraining p16-mediated senescence of progenitor cells: p53 is protective in BubR1 insufficiency.
against_or_risk.sentence: We show that p53 delays functional decline of skeletal muscle and fat in a p21-dependent fashion by inhibiting p16(Ink4a)-mediated senescence of progenitor cells.
against_or_risk.caveats: Genetic data. Implication: a p53 inhibitor would be predicted to worsen muscle/fat decline (and tumour risk) in this context.
against_or_risk.title: p21 both attenuates and drives senescence and aging in BubR1 progeroid mice.

against_or_risk.finding: Aneuploidy activates p53 and loss of p53 drastically accelerates tumour development in two aneuploidy models.
against_or_risk.sentence: We show that aneuploidy activates p53 and that loss of p53 drastically accelerates tumor development in two independent aneuploidy models.
against_or_risk.caveats: Mouse genetic data; basis for the concern that p53 inhibition is dangerous in an aneuploidy-prone, tumour-prone child.
against_or_risk.title: The ATM-p53 pathway suppresses aneuploidy-induced tumorigenesis.

against_or_risk.finding: SIRT2 overexpression did not extend lifespan in mice with normal BubR1 (benefit appears tied to low BubR1).
against_or_risk.sentence: Overall, we conclude that strategies to enhance SIRT2 protein levels may not lead to increased longevity.
against_or_risk.caveats: Wild-type background; moderates the NAD+/SIRT2 hypothesis.
against_or_risk.title: SIRT2 transgenic over-expression does not impact lifespan in mice.

naming_notes: universe.json contains "DASATINIB ANHYDROUS" but not "DASATINIB"; "NIACINAMIDE" (= nicotinamide) but not "NICOTINAMIDE"; SIROLIMUS, EVEROLIMUS, TEMSIROLIMUS, METFORMIN, CHLOROQUINE, VENETOCLAX, RUXOLITINIB, PALBOCICLIB, RIBOCICLIB, ABEMACICLIB are present.
_notes: Literature hypotheses, not clinical evidence or medical advice. No doses. No patient data.
verified=true means the sentence was found as a substring (ignoring whitespace and HTML entities) in the Europe PMC abstract, or in the full-text XML when source_section=full_text.
